* Collected fees from 01 Grade X and 01 XII students and tallied the physical cash.
* Given the Grade X Marksheet certificate to the student.(ID-4846)
* Successfully obtained LOC signatures and verified NO DUES clearance with parents (2) for both Grade X and XII students.
* Updated the Grade X Excel Sheet with the latest LOC verification and payment status.
* Completed the LOC data verification with Anshu Ma'am using the file and LOC checklist (GRADE X IOTA & OMEGA).
* Completed editing of Grade XI photos with name and date labels; shared with Rajneesh Sir.
* Exported student data (ID-2395) to Dropbox for the UDISE portal.


*OTHER WORK:*

* Prepared the Biometric attendance record of Teaching, Non-Teaching, Admin, Transport, Guard and 4th grade employee given by Principal Sir.
* Bus Scanning (R-57)
* Collected homework feedback from the first-floor classes and shared it via a Google Form.
